content.rendered:
MORATORIUM WEEK IS JULY 28TH – AUGUST 3RD

No contact between coaches and athletes is allowed during moratorium week; no athletic activities, including conditioning/practices.

FALL

Fall sports include: football, volleyball, cross country, soccer, dance and cheer.

(Dance and cheer tryouts were in May 2025)

Tryouts for Fall sports begin on August 18th. Deadline to register for Fall sports is August 15th.

WINTER

Winter sports include: basketball, wrestling and swimming (dance and cheer continue).

Tryouts for Winter sports begin on November 17th. Deadline to register for Winter sports is November 14th.

SPRING

Spring sports include: track & field, baseball, softball, tennis, golf, lacrosse.

Tryouts for Spring sports begin on March 2rd. Deadline to register for Spring sports is February 27th.

PARTICIPATING ATHLETES NEED TO DO THE FOLLOWING PRIOR TO TRYOUTS:

  1. Register
  2. Have a current physical on file in our Athletic Office (physicals must be submitted on the OSAA physical form)

Physicals can be submitted online through our secure upload portal.

Physicals MUST be completed prior to attending tryouts.  

Important Information

Athletes must have a current physical on file in the athletic office at the high school in order to participate.  Physicals are good for two years and must be done on the OSAA physical form. Please email the form to a agillett@sherwood.k12.or.us.  

PARTICIPATION FEE:

Participation fee is $275 per sport and $175 per activity (cheer and dance). There is an individual cap of $675 and a family cap of $1375 per year.  Fees are due prior to the first competition. To pay for athletic fees, log into your ParentVue account or pay directly at the high school bookkeeping office; three month payment contracts are also available.  

  • Participation fees may be reduced by half if approved for the Free/Reduced Lunch Program. This form must be filled out every year to qualify.  
  • The Permission to Share Information form (for those that have been approved for the free/reduced lunch program) must also be signed.  This form gives the state permission to release your approved status to the high school; this allows us to waive your fees.
  • Link to free/reduced lunch application and the Permission to Share Information in English and Spanish:  click here 

GRADE REQUIREMENTS FOR ATHLETES:

Athletes must have passed 4 classes and received a 2.0 GPA for the grading period prior to the athletic season they are participating in (excludes freshmen for fall sports).  If an athlete receives a GPA lower than 2.0 they will have to sit out of competitions for the first two weeks (they can still participate in practices). They must also have their current grades checked regularly during the season and sign an academic contract with our Dean of Students. Please see the Athletic Handbook and the OSAA rules for additional grade requirements.

Additional Forms

These additional forms may be required by the district if your student is a transfer from another district, is being home schooled, is attending a private school but lives in the Sherwood School District, or is a foreign exchange student:
